# kind: # Read by round.sh: data, so the settings tree can change without touching the script. Tab separated; # lines are notes.
# layout: the home layouts and the cards: key = what `saver.sh homelayout` takes. name = Arabic name. marker: a word that is on the home in that layout.

# section: the sections of the ONE settings tree of 4.4 beta 4, in its order. value = the extras after `am start --activity-clear-task -n sa.urtv.screensaver/.SettingsActivity`; marker = a row that is always drawn near the top of that section (from the UI session's list, work/44b4-settings-ia).
# style: the settings styles, each opened to every section above. value = the word of `--es settingsstyle` in am broadcast -n sa.urtv.screensaver/.SaverReceiver -a sa.urtv.screensaver.SET
# adhan: the per-prayer states set by command and read back (music.sh adhan state <prayer> <state>)
